package.description: The ADN Silent Switch Finder first analyses the setup file. It can identify dozens of installers. It can also extract information from (among others) MSI files.

en-US.description: The ADN Silent Switch Finder first analyses the setup file. It can identify dozens of installers. It can also extract information from (among others) MSI files.
en-US.longDescription: Looking for a hassle-free way to streamline your software installations? AppDeploy Silent Switch Finder is here to simplify the process for you! This powerful yet user-friendly application empowers you to locate and activate silent installer commands across a wide array of software applications, making installation a breeze.
en-US.name: ADN Silent Switch Finder
